Last weekend, we investigated the Bosporus, one of the two straits that separate the Mediterranean Sea from the Black Sea. Together with the Dardanelles, the strait closer to the Mediterranean, the question of who has control over these two narrows has shaped the history of the region and the world. 
As a little midweek bonus, I thought I’d share with you some really nice images of the Bosporus that I enjoyed but didn’t fit into the narrative of the weekend newsletter!...
